title: A Plausible Explanation Is Enough to Mislead Multimodal Judges
abstract: arXiv:2610.22631v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) increasingly serve as judges in training and evaluation pipelines, often assessing answers together with explanations. Although AI judges are sensitive to textual factors, it remains unclear whether ordinary plausible explanations can sway judgments requiring visual verification. We introduce JUPE, a visual-question-answering (VQA)-style benchmark that fixes answers while varying explanations.   Across 14 MLLM judges, ordinary explanations that sound plausible mislead judges, with effects comparable on average to deliberately persuasive arguments. Plain justifications and chain-of-thought rationales reduce rejection of incorrect answers by 12.7 and 13.8 percentage points, respectively. We call this failure plausibility capture. Using signal detection theory, we find a significant mean shift in decision criterion toward acceptance, without a clear change in mean discriminability. Explanations swa

translated_title: 貌似合理的解释就足以误导多模态评审模型
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型越来越多地在训练和评估流程中充当“评审”角色，通常会同时评估答案及其解释。尽管AI评审对文本因素较为敏感，但普通貌似合理的解释是否能够左右那些需要视觉验证的判断，目前仍不清楚。我们提出了JUPE，一个视觉问答（VQA）风格的基准，它在固定答案的同时改变解释。在14个多模态大模型评审上，听起来合理的普通解释即可误导评审，其平均效果与刻意构造的说服性论证相当。简单的理由说明和思维链式论证分别使错误答案被拒绝的概率降低了12.7和13.8个百分点。我们将这种失败现象称为“合理性俘获”。借助信号检测理论，我们发现评审的判断标准发生了显著的均值偏移，趋向于接受答案，而平均辨别能力并无明显变化。
tldr: 提出JUPE基准并揭示“合理性俘获”现象——仅仅貌似合理的普通解释就足以误导多模态大模型评审接受错误答案，其影响与刻意说服性论证相当。
